audience: Egyptian business owners, marketers and creative recruiters scrolling Reels who judge an agency by its motion work
promise: PIXEL Plus builds motion that is designed down to the spring, the curve and the beat — shown in one continuous 20-second reel
cta: ابدأ مشروعك — ابعتلنا رسالة (no phone/URL invented)
direction: Reference-matched to an owner-supplied UI micro-interaction reel: ONE black box morphs through interface states on a warm paper canvas, driven by a cursor; content blurs out and in, long calm holds, quick springy morphs. Original Arabic copy and states, Alexandria + Aref Ruqaa, 144 BPM electro-shaabi score, brand card on pixel-iris blue with the PIXEL Plus character.

assets.rights: Alexandria, Aref Ruqaa, IBM Plex Sans Arabic, Instrument Serif — SIL OFL 1.1 (see ASSETS.md)
Original PIXEL Plus character modelled in code (film 6); reused as the brand card cameo

sound.note: Synthesised in film7/score.mjs (lib/audio.mjs + lib/sfx.mjs + custom reed/808/darbuka voices): 144 BPM electro-shaabi in D Hijaz, tresillo kick, half-time clap, reed lead, darbuka maqsum, UI sounds on every click. No voiceover.

creative.viewer: a business owner or a creative director who has 20 seconds and is deciding whether this agency can really do motion
creative.problem: agency reels are long montages that don't prove craft; ads feel template-made
creative.promise: every interaction here is designed: springs, curves, counters, re-composition and type, on one beat
creative.evidence: the reel itself — each state demonstrates a technique the studio really performs; the stats card is labelled an illustrative example
creative.emotion: confident, precise, delighted — a tiny product demo that keeps surprising
creative.motif: one black box that morphs; the cursor as the narrator; the square pixel at the end
creative.light: soft paper canvas with a breathing glow; hard black objects with long soft shadows

typography.text: Aref Ruqaa Bold accent words, IBM Plex Sans Arabic UI labels

creative.camera: flat stage, cursor-driven 3-D tilt of the box, beat pulse; no camera moves
creative.motion: springs with overshoot, content blur-in/out, count-ups, line draw, live re-wrap, whip / flip / punch words
creative.sound: 144 BPM electro-shaabi: tresillo kick, half-time clap, reed lead in D Hijaz, darbuka maqsum, 808 slides, UI clicks on every interaction
creative.pacing: one bar per scene; calm holds, fast morphs; drop on the type scene (13.3); brand drop 16.7
creative.payoff: the check becomes the brand: PIXEL Plus, the character on the wordmark, «بنحرّك فكرتك.»

shots.purpose: opening title + the «ولّد إعلان» button; cursor clicks on beat 3
the button morphs into a video player that plays the film's own progress, audio-reactive bars
slider drag (frame rate 24→60) then it shrinks into a switch that flips on
segmented control: selector slides with a spring to «موشن» then «فيديو»
a stats card: tabs, a counting number and a drawn line (labelled as an illustrative example)
an easing-curve editor: handles dragged, a ball runs the curve
one frame re-composes through 9:16, 1:1, 16:9, 4:5 on four beats
a search palette types «كل إطار» and picks «كل إطار هو كود»
the picked row becomes a full-screen black stage: four words on four hits (حركة / إيقاع / صوت / فكرة.)
back to the button; click; spinner; check; pixel iris to blue
PIXEL Plus resolves from pixels; the character stands on the wordmark; tagline and CTA
